theme: Original Primeval Dragons - the Elder Dragons and their Primeval heirs (Phase 6 Pilot 2)
status: UNAPPROVED PROPOSAL - awaiting Cory's review; not approved, not locked, not certified
narrator_note: A five-colour dragon procession. The five Legends Elder Dragons and their Core Set 2019 cards, Ugin, the Elder Dragon War, the Piru/Chromium aftermath with Dihada and Dakkon, and the Invasion Primeval Dragons speaking through their printed flavor. The Ur-Dragon is the commander only as a thematic progenitor.
canon_caveats: A003/A004 (who struck first; Ugin's perspective) are CANON_DISPUTED; no card here asserts either account.
The Ur-Dragon (C17) is not asserted to be the 'ur-dragon' of the Invasion Attendant flavor; it is a thematic commander (LORE_INSPIRED).
Original Legends Elder Dragon cards are named character cards; their art is not certified as any specific war scene.
Darigaaz, Dromar and Treva are graded CANON_REFERENCE as named character cards only. Pack A2 sources name Crosis and Rith directly, not the other three.
Printed flavor proves what Wizards printed on the card, not that the illustration depicts a specific story scene.
unrepresentable_in_identity: None by colour: five-colour identity admits every Elder and Primeval Dragon card.
Chromium Rhuell's banishment and Piru's death at Corondor have no dedicated card; Piru and Dakkon cards stand in (A021-A022).

beats.title: I. The Elder Dragons of Dominaria and the war Bolas started

cards.name: Nicol Bolas
cards.why: The original Elder Dragon card. In the Chronicle he provokes the dragon clans, and Wizards credits him with instigating the Elder Dragon War.

cards.name: Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas, the Arisen
cards.why: Core Set 2019 Elder Dragon reprint cycle: Bolas as a Grixis Elder Dragon.

cards.name: Ugin, the Spirit Dragon
cards.why: Bolas's twin. The Chronicle shows the young twins meeting Arcades, Chromium and Palladia-Mors.

cards.name: Arcades Sabboth
cards.why: Original Legends Elder Dragon. The Chronicle has Arcades leading followers into the war against his kin.

cards.name: Arcades, the Strategist
cards.why: Core Set 2019 Arcades. A named character card; its defensive mechanics are not lore evidence.

cards.name: Chromium
cards.why: Original Legends Elder Dragon, met by the twins in the Chronicle.

cards.name: Chromium, the Mutable
cards.why: Chromium survived the war with Piru (Wizards' Piru biography).

cards.name: Palladia-Mors
cards.why: Original Legends Elder Dragon whose branch Bolas deliberately incited.

cards.name: Palladia-Mors, the Ruiner
cards.why: Printed flavor: sister of Nicol Bolas, survivor of the Elder Dragon War.

cards.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
cards.why: Original Legends Elder Dragon. His descendants raided Bolas's kingdom, by their own account.

cards.name: Vaevictis Asmadi, the Dire
cards.why: Core Set 2019 Vaevictis; a named character card.

cards.name: The Elder Dragon War
cards.why: Names the war. Its chapters are not certified as a literal battlefield reconstruction.

beats.title: II. After the war: Piru, Chromium, Dihada and Dakkon

cards.name: Piru, the Volatile
cards.why: War survivor and Chromium's mate. His death cracked Dominaria at the Dueling Chasm of Corondor.

cards.name: Geyadrone Dihada
cards.why: Millennia later, Dihada bound Piru and Chromium to fight Dakkon.

cards.name: Dakkon, Shadow Slayer
cards.why: Dakkon slew Piru and banished Chromium.

cards.name: Dakkon Blackblade
cards.why: The original Legends card of the same Dakkon.
